description: Put an earlier version of a film back (an id from list_versions). The film it replaces is kept as a version too, so undo_film cancels the restore.

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

version.description: A version id from list_versions, e.g. 2026-10-06T21-42-21-123Z

name: restore_version
title: Restore a version
